dct_description_sm: We mapped permafrost terrain disturbances (PTDs) in PlanetScope monthly cloud-free satellite imagery from August and September 2023 for the Nacho Nyk Tag (Stewart River) watershed, digitized retrogressive thaw slump (RTS) scar areas, and used random forest machine learning to model PTD susceptibility to support community-led land-use planning by the First Nation of Nacho Nyk Dun.
dct_title_s: Permafrost terrain disturbances and susceptibility in the Nacho Nyak Tage (Stewart River) Watershed, Yukon, Canada
